hud.countrysidedays.title: Countryside Days
message.countrysidedays.restaurant_ancho: This counter is now registered as the restaurant kitchen.
message.countrysidedays.herb_prepared: You trimmed the wild herb and placed it on the counter.
message.countrysidedays.herb_already_pre: Prepared wild herb is already waiting here.
message.countrysidedays.need_herb_first: Prepare wild herb before cooking the river fish.
message.countrysidedays.stew_completed: Country stew completed! Total meals prepared: %s.
message.countrysidedays.counter_waiting_: The prepared herb is ready. Add river fish next.
Use the restaurant counter while holding wild herb to begin preparing a meal.
message.countrysidedays.starter_kit: You received a countryside recipe notebook and fishing rod. Your home, farm, restaurant, and ranch are already waiting in the village.
message.countrysidedays.homestead_ready: The countryside village is ready. Village centre: %s, %s, %s
message.countrysidedays.flat_world_requi: §eCountryside Days only supports Superflat worlds. Select 'Superflat' when creating a new world.
message.countrysidedays.keep_inventory_e: §aHealing rules are active: death never removes your items or equipment.
message.countrysidedays.meet_resident: Read the residents' signs and speak to them at their workplaces during the day.
message.countrysidedays.property_deed: §6[Homestead Deed] §fHome %s,%s,%s / Farm %s,%s,%s / Restaurant %s,%s,%s / Ranch %s,%s,%s. Roads and signs connect every property.
message.countrysidedays.property_break_d: §e%s belongs to someone and cannot be broken without permission.
message.countrysidedays.property_contain: §eYou cannot take items from %s without the owner's permission.
message.countrysidedays.restaurant_name_: §eOnly the restaurant owner can rename this sign.
§eUse a name tag that has been renamed in an anvil.
message.countrysidedays.restaurant_close: §eThe restaurant is closed. Please return between morning and sunset.
message.countrysidedays.wild_herb_found: You found an edible wild herb in the grass.
message.countrysidedays.river_fish_caugh: You brought up an extra fresh river fish.
message.countrysidedays.resident_first_g: §6[Grandma Boksun] §fThe home and restaurant are yours. Cook stew from wild herbs and river fish, then welcome daytime guests.
message.countrysidedays.resident_progres: §6[Grandma Boksun] §fYou have served %s guests already and earned %s village coins.
message.countrysidedays.farmer_guidance: §2[Farmer Hangyeol] §fYour farm is east of the restaurant. Replant the rows after harvesting them.
message.countrysidedays.rancher_guidance: §6[Rancher Somi] §fYour ranch is at the end of the southern road. Take your time caring for its cows and sheep.
message.countrysidedays.hall_guidance: §b[Hall Keeper Doyun] §fThe town hall is a shared place for guidance and events. A notice board and festivals will be added later.
message.countrysidedays.customer_order: §e[Day-tripper Minsu] §fCould I have one warm country stew scented with wild herbs?
message.countrysidedays.customer_already: §e[Day-tripper Minsu] §fThat was wonderful. I will visit again tomorrow.
message.countrysidedays.customer_served: §aYou served the stew and received %s village coins. Total guests: %s
